Dadan Hindayana (born October 22, 1966) is an Indonesian politician and agricultural scientist who served as the first head of the National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional, BGN) from November 2024 to June 2025.

Early life and education
Dadan was born in Ciamis, West Java, and attended the Bogor Agricultural University (IPB). After completing his undergraduate degree in entomology in 1990, Dadan pursued a master's degree in biology at the Leiden University in the Netherlands. Dadan later got his PhD from IPB.

Career
Early career

After completing his PhD, he became a professor at IPB's Department of Plant Protection. In 2016, Dadan was appointed the director of the Learning Facility Center.

Politician

Dadan joined the Gerindra party and has been active in the party since 2023.

Head of the National Nutrition Agency (BGN)

In November 2024, Dadan was appointed by President Prabowo Subianto as the inaugural head of the National Nutrition Agency (Badan Gizi Nasional, BGN), a newly established government agency tasked with overseeing the Free Nutritious Meals program. In April 2025, Dadan resigned from the BGN following a public controversy. Some said that he was fired. His firing came after several controversial issues concerning the Free Nutritious Meals program, including instances of students suffering from food poisoning, alleged budget mismanagement, and an undisclosed deal with Chinese companies to provide laboratory equipment for the program. He was succeeded by Tugu Aris Munandar, who served as the acting head until June 2025. He was replaced by Titan Syailendra.
